Svendborg is a Danish municipality featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Regional Clinical Quality Improvement Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report serves as a critical tool for local quality development and benchmarking in the Danish healthcare system, evaluating clinical treatment quality across national, regional, and all 98 Danish municipal levels [^src1].

Within the report, Svendborg is assessed under Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke (apoplexy) via anticoagulant treatment using data from the DanStroke registry [^src1]. Svendborg's specific municipal performance is recorded in a tabular breakdown, documenting 8 stroke events out of a patient base of 1,784, alongside its standardized rates and confidence intervals [^src1]. Because the entity is mentioned only once in the provided corpus as a row in this data table, no further relational, historical, or contextual details are available.
